conclusion: make_context.py --check is structurally blind to length-neutral in-place helper renames across all 49 modules declaring __all__ (0/299 unexported private symbols detected, 0.0%), because module_api filters strictly by __all__ and line count is unchanged. In non-__all__ modules, detection is 100% (4/4), and any edit altering line count is 100% detected via the line-count tell.
confidence: High. Measured across all 67 scanned repository modules on 25 curated mutants and 305 exhaustive symbol mutations in an isolated sandbox with clean baseline and undo controls.

threads.what: Public top-level definitions in __all__ modules that are omitted from __all__ are omitted from CONTEXT.md.
threads.why_it_might_matter: Developers adding public functions might forget to export them in __all__, leaving them absent from the machine-readable index.
threads.first_step: Consider adding an opt-in lint rule in make_context.py that checks if any non-underscore top-level definition in an __all__ module is missing from __all__.
